title: Urban Designer / Planner I
description:
**Overview**
------------

The Urban Designer I/ Urban Planner I will support multidisciplinary teams in the planning, design, analysis, and delivery of projects ranging from public realm improvements, streetscapes, parks, campuses, transit-oriented developments, mixed-use districts, new towns, and large-scale masterplans to strategic infrastructure and regional planning projects. The role requires strong design thinking, analytical capability, digital proficiency, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple disciplines and geographies.

**Your role**
-------------

  

* Contribute to projects across all design stages, from visioning, feasibility, concept development and master planning through to detailed design and implementation support.
* Take ownership of work and design under the supervision of Senior Landscape Architects & Urban Designers
* Work on a program for the project and proactively advise Senior team members of any issue which affects the efficient completion of the project.
* Set out / agree design standards and parameters with senior team members.
* Responsible for completion of specifically assigned tasks to time and cost.
* Assist in preparing design studies, reports, presentations, technical documentation, and client deliverables.
* Undertake site analysis, precedent studies, benchmarking, and contextual research.
* Support the production of high-quality graphics, diagrams, visualizations, reports, and presentation materials.
* Willing to undertake and be part of interdisciplinary technical co-ordination. Participate in internal design reviews, workshops, and interdisciplinary coordination meetings.
* The individual will be required to travel if required, at times to the different AtkinsRéalis offices and sites globally and interface with the team based there.
* Understand the project workflow and assess for any possible enhancements & integration of new software & automation.
* Assist to achieve design & workflow innovation within the scope of projects.
* Assist in developing innovative, sustainable and resilient design solutions aligned with project objectives.

**About you**
-------------

  

* A Master's degree in Urban Design/ Planning from universities of National or International repute is a must.
* Bachelor's degree holders in Urban Design/ Planning or Architecture will be considered, if they can showcase relevant experience in Urban / Planning Project Stages. Including Design, Documentation , Policy work and site implementation.
* Chartered or candidates on Pathway shall be considered the same being an added advantage.
* Experience level of 2-5 years required for the Urban Designer / Planner
* Must have relevant experience delivering Urban Design / Public Realm / Planning projects. Should be able to explain the projects over all & their specific involvement. Experience in global market regions will be considered an additional advantage.
* Must be competent in design detailing and construction techniques.
* Must be conversant of the evolving standards of the profession primarily with respective to collaborative and multi-disciplinary design.
* All candidates must be able to self-classify their key skill competency and stronghold in one or more of the following - design, technical, innovation, strategy. And be able to demonstrate the same through their projects.
* Software proficiency expected in a combination of the following - AutoCAD, GIS, Rhino, Adobe Suite, MS Office, AI Automation & Prompt engineering. Willingness & skill to time effectively learn any new or above-mentioned software that may be part of the project requirement.
* Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English.
* Capable of working on own initiative or as part of a larger multidisciplinary team.
* Have a logical and organized approach to project delivery and able to follow instructions and guidance by senior team members.
* Able to identify and communicate concerns of the project/team to immediate Line Manager.
* Able to discuss career goals and aspirations. Having the ability to structure & work on independent subject research will be considered an additional advantage.
* Willingness to share information and knowledge with team members.

**Reward & benefits**
---------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

title: Associate Product Designer
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Position Summary**

We're looking for a UX Designer to join our Developer Experience team, where you'll help shape how developers discover, integrate, and build on our platform. You'll partner closely with product managers, engineers, content strategists, and researchers to simplify complex technical workflows into experiences that feel clear, efficient, and empowering for developers. This is a great opportunity for someone who's passionate about developer-facing products and wants to have direct impact on how users experience our platform from their very first interaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design intuitive, scalable user experiences that solve complex customer and business

problems.

* Create end-to-end user flows, interaction models, wireframes, and prototypes for new and existing product experiences.
* Simplify complex workflows and information into experiences that are clear, efficient, and easy to use.
* Establish consistent information architecture, navigation patterns, and interaction models across product experiences.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, content strategists, researchers, and other stakeholders throughout the design process.
* Conduct discovery activities and incorporate research, analytics, and customer feedback into design decisions.
* Validate and iterate on solutions through testing, feedback, and continuous learning.
* Demonstrate an understanding of design systems, reusable patterns, and accessibility best practices
* Produce design artifacts and documentation that support implementation and cross-functional alignment.
* Help shape experiences that improve adoption, usability, and overall customer satisfaction.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in product design, interaction design, UX design, or a related field
* Portfolio demonstrating thoughtful, user-centered design solutions for complex products or workflows
* Experience collaborating effectively with distributed or global teams across multiple time zones
* Experience using research, analytics, and customer feedback to inform design decisions
* Strong information architecture, interaction design, and problem-solving skills
* Experience designing complex workflows, tools, platforms, or enterprise applications
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and translate complex concepts into intuitive user experiences
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain design

decisions and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners

* Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of work, manage priorities, and

drive projects forward with appropriate guidance and support

* Proficiency with modern design tools and component-based design workflows
* Experience working in agile or iterative product development environments

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience designing B2B, SaaS, platform, or ecosystem-based products.
* Familiarity with developer-facing, partner-facing, or workflow-oriented products and experiences.
* Experience designing onboarding, self-service, configuration, or administration workflows.
* Experience working within established design systems and contributing reusable patterns.
* Accessibility design experience and familiarity with inclusive design practices.
* Curiosity about complex systems and a passion for simplifying challenging workflows into intuitive user experiences.

**What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you will:

* Design intuitive experiences that simplify complex workflows and make it easier for customers to accomplish their goals.
* Build strong partnerships with product managers, engineers, content strategists, researchers, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Use research, analytics, customer feedback, and sound design principles to inform decisions and continuously improve experiences.
* Contribute to a consistent and scalable user experience through thoughtful application of design systems, reusable patterns, and accessibility best practices.
* Take ownership of your work, communicate proactively, and drive high-quality design outcomes from discovery through delivery.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on meaningful financial products used at scale
* Collaborative product trio model with design, product, and engineering
* Exposure to complex platform and ecosystem design challenges
* Career growth within a structured design organization
* Hybrid work environment

Please submit your resume and a portfolio with case studies showing end-to-end design work. Include a brief note on relevant experience in data-dense or regulated product environments.

**You will work with**

As a Product Designer on our Core Security Platform team, you will collaborate with a multidisciplinary group of product managers and engineers to shape the future of the foundational platforms that power all BP applications. Your work will influence the design and usability of critical systems, ensuring seamless, intuitive, and scalable experiences that drive innovation across the organization.

  
  

Let me tell you about the role

A Product Designer at bp doesnʼt just create designs — they shape experiences that matter.

Youʼll design innovative digital experiences, from apps to websites, that are user-friendly, visually appealing, and accessible to everyone. This role includes understanding user needs, conducting research, creating wireframes and prototypes, collaborating with product and project managers, business partners, and engineers, and ensuring a seamless user experience from concept to final product. They blend creativity, problem-solving, and collaboration to craft products that solve real-world problems and meet user needs while aligning with our business objectives. This is your opportunity to bring bold ideas to life, working alongside a passionate team to define the future of digital experiences.

  
  

What you will deliver

**User research & analysis:** Conduct user research to understand diverse customer needs, behaviors, and challenges, and use these insights to inform your designs. Youʼll ensure our products truly resonate with our users.

  
  

**Wireframes & prototypes:** Bring ideas to life by creating wireframes and prototypes that showcase the productʼs structure, functionality, and flow. Youʼll iterate quickly to find the best

solutions before development.

  
  

**Inclusive user experiences:** Champion accessibility and inclusivity, ensuring that our designs meet or exceed global accessibility standards (WCAG). Implement strategies to enhance user experiences for all, with a focus on individuals with disabilities creating innovative, user-centred solutions that prioritise inclusion and accessibility at every stage.

  
  

**User Experience (UX) design:** Craft intuitive and seamless user experiences, ensuring the product is easy to use, accessible, and meets user needs by applying established UX principles and design standards.

  
  

**User Interface (UI) design:** Design the visual elements of the product, including typography, color schemes, icons, and layout, ensuring the design is visually appealing and aligns with brand guidelines.

  
  

**Cross-functional collaboration:** Partner with product managers, developers, and other teams to turn ideas into reality, ensuring designs are technically feasible and align with business objectives.

  
  

**Usability testing:** Test and refine your designs through usability sessions, gathering feedback to deliver intuitive and seamless user experiences.

  
  

**Documentation & guidelines:** Maintain detailed design documentation to ensure transparency and consistency across projects and teams, ensuring all design decisions and processes are well-documented for future reference.

  
  

**What youʼll need to be successful (experience and qualifications)**

* A Bachelorʼs degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field — or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience as a Product Designer or similar role.
* A strong portfolio showcasing your design skills, including UX and UI projects.
* Expertise in tools like Figma, Sketch, and Adobe Creative Suite.
* A deep understanding of UX/UI principles, accessibility standards, applying established UX principles and design standards
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, thriving in a team environment.
* A passion for creating accessible, user-first designs.
  

  

Preferred skills and experience

* Hands-on experience with front-end development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
* Experience conducting user research and usability testing.
* Familiarity with Agile or other iterative design and development methodologies.
* A commitment to accessibility, with knowledge of WCAG or other accessibility frameworks.
  

  

At this level, the Product Designer demonstrates proficiency in user research and analysis, leading studies and synthesizing insights to inform design strategies. Under general supervision, they independently create high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes, contributing to iterative design processes. Their UX and UI designs effectively balance user needs, technical constraints, and business goals, ensuring functional and visually appealing

outcomes. Collaboration with cross-functional teams is a core responsibility, with active participation in workshops, brainstorming sessions, and feedback loops to align stakeholders and deliver impactful designs.

description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Overview**

At Okta, we're building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we're specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our customers' workforce and users but to ask, "what more can we make possible?"

As a Staff Product Designer for Okta, you'll work with a globally distributed design team to apply your craft and expertise on a range of products and services. Our culture provides the opportunity to explore the technologies we're researching and investing in. Some of your work will be functional, practical user experience design, where you will help our design team drive cohesive user experience across Okta's portfolio of products. Other work will be speculative, generative explorations that you carry out in collaboration and partnership across the organization to flesh out, frame, and help prioritize solutions in an ever-evolving and complex, often ambiguous, problem space.

  

**The Finer Print**

You will lead user experience strategy and execution for our Okta Research & Development (ORD) business unit. Specifically, ORD will solve every identity use case at work – for all types of people (employees, business partners, contractors, frontline workers), for all types of resources (SaaS, servers, privileged resources, machines, etc.), for the largest and most secure businesses in the world. As a designer, your focus will be on helping us build a secure, trusted, and unified platform with deep integrations.

  

**In this role, you have the opportunity to:**

* Lead a holistic, human-centered approach to design.
* Guide and oversee the UX strategy alongside cross-functional partners, collaborating to take products from concept to launch and define the long-term strategy for your product area.
* Design and facilitate co-creation design workshops with Product Management, Engineering, and Design to define opportunities within our products to solve valuable customer problems.
* Craft user-centered artifacts and end-to-end journeys to align teams contributing to Workforce Identity Management around the broader user experience.
* Collaborate with other Okta designers to ensure consistency across interface experiences across different user scenarios.
* Inspire teams to think bigger and act smaller, instilling an iterative process and fail-forward mentality to design simple and delightful user interfaces for new and existing Okta products.
* Advocate, mentor, and educate on the benefits of design thinking to product teams and new designers alike; partnering with UX team members to uphold our principles and standards.
* Mentor junior designers and contribute toward team-level and design practice and process improvements.
* Work with Design Leadership to define and drive the frameworks, contracts, and standards for others to be able to then build on top of and add value to, ensuring the quality of UX delivery.
* Find creative ways to continuously learn from customers and users; collaborating with user researchers to research and synthesize user needs to help conceive, define, test, and evolve solutions for our users across a range of mediums and experiences; Advocate for users and deliver user and customer outcomes in a dynamic work environment.
* Help product designers create success metrics to illustrate a clear understanding of how their designs impact customers.
* Present work, concepts, and new ideas to cross-functional team members, adjacent teams, and senior leadership; working to distill complex technical problems into clear, conceptual models and simple, elegant solutions.
* Keep abreast of competitor products and industry trends, including the practical application of AI in the design process; Perform competitive and comparative analysis to understand existing patterns.

  

**Who We Are Looking For**

* You have experience leading cross-discipline teams and exemplify leadership.
* You are passionate about solving complex problems, crafting and sharing product and design UX principles to help teams deliver cohesive user experiences.
* You are great at collaborating, sharing work early and often, and seeking constructive feedback from peers and stakeholders.
* You are a pragmatist who actively uses AI tools to improve and accelerate your day-to-day design workflow.
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI-powered design tools (e.g., for ideation, asset generation, or prototyping) in your daily design activities.
* You have the heart of a teacher and can help mentor and train people. You build and share empathy with people to deeply understand them and their needs.
* You are a thought leader, undertaking explorations into new technologies and territories while also delivering practical designs.
* You see design as a partner in shaping strategic and operational product and UX outcomes; comfortable owning all stages of design for multiple teams within a given product area.
* You bring a systems-thinking lens to the conversation.
* You are passionate about supporting teams with a wide variety of experience, backgrounds, and interests.
* Your portfolio will show that you've worked on complex and/or technical projects across all aspects of the design process (conceptual design, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design).
* You are adept at working in a diverse, globally distributed team and have experience with remote collaboration tools.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer, with a portfolio showcasing shipped B2B or enterprise products.
* Degree in a related field or relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer.
* Proficient in Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite, and/or similar design tools.
* Possesses at least a basic understanding of HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
* Can provide a digital portfolio that showcases solid skills across a variety of projects, including work that has been seen and used successfully in actual products. (Portfolio link required when applying.)

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**

* Create and edit eLearning, videos, presentations, and infographics.
* Operate tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, After Effects, Illustrator, InDesign, CorelDraw, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Microsoft PowerPoint design, etc.
	+ Working knowledge of tools such as StrivR \- virtual reality platform, Gooroo, HeyGen, Eleven Labs, Canva, Vimio, Apple Vision Pro, Adobe Express, various Google AI tools (Gemini, NotebookLM, etc)
* Create and edit motion graphics, audio\-video, and animations.
* Translate concepts into working models—while keeping in mind the design aesthetics, brand guidelines, templates, and latest design standards.
* Create graphics and layouts for eLearning, PowerPoint presentations, product illustrations, digital banners, e\-mails, collaterals, newsletters, social media creatives, web layouts, etc.
* Conceptualize slides, displays, and templates into visually appealing designs to ensure maximum engagement.
* Ensure compliance with the company’s guidelines, deadlines, and latest design standards.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any field
* Proficient in working with the following tools:
	+ Adobe Creative Cloud Applications for video editing, interactive media, etc.
	+ Adobe After Effects
	+ MS PowerPoint
	+ Graphics/Motion Graphics
	+ Adobe Photoshop
	+ Adobe Illustrator
	+ Articulate Storyline and Rise
	+ StrivR \- virtual reality platform
	+ Content Development platforms such as Gooroo, HeyGen, Eleven Labs, Canva, Vimio, Apple Vision Pro, Adobe Express
	+ Google AI tools (Gemini, NotebookLM, etc.)
* A good understanding of the audience perspective and the ability to perceive content in various business settings.
* In\-depth knowledge of infographics, data visualization concepts, and PowerPoint's graphing tools.
* A well\-rounded experience in corporate branding, layout, color theory, typography, along with excellent written and verbal communication skills
